name: memory_extract_environment_knowledge
content: Extract environment knowledge from the following episodic memory data.
Analyze the actions taken and observations to identify websites, APIs, CLI tools,
and other environments the agent interacted with.
## Source Episodes ({episode_count} episodes)
{source_json}
## Source Text Representation
{source_text}
## Target Tier Schema
{tier_schema}
## Instructions
1. Scan each episode's `memory_candidates`, `memory_updates`, actions_taken, observations, outcome_summary, final output excerpts, and artifact_output references for reusable tool/site interactions.
2. Infer the `kind` from the action type:
- Browser actions (navigate, click, type, scroll) -> kind: "browser"
- HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) -> kind: "http"
- Shell/bash commands -> kind: "bash"
- File operations -> kind: "file"
- Other tool calls -> kind: "tool"
3. Group interactions by environment:
- Browser: group by domain + path pattern (use `*` for variable segments)
- HTTP: group by domain + endpoint pattern
- Bash: group by command name
4. For each distinct environment, emit one entry with:
- `name`: MUST equal `environment_key` (required for deduplication)
- `environment_key`: "{kind}:{identifier}"
- `kind`: the inferred kind
- `page_type`: classify the page/endpoint/tool type
- `layout_notes`: structural observations (DOM layout, response shapes, flag patterns)
- `known_blockers`: obstacles encountered (cookie banners, CAPTCHAs, rate limits, auth walls)
- `successful_patterns`: what interaction sequences worked
- `failure_modes`: what failed and why
- `auth_required`: "yes", "no", or "unknown"
- `last_used`: most recent timestamp from the episodes for this environment
- `use_count`: "1" for new entries, or increment existing value if updating a known environment

5. Skip environments where nothing notable happened. Do not store one-off local test URLs, task IDs, execution IDs, or temporary artifacts unless they reveal a reusable interaction pattern, blocker, or tool behavior.
6. Conform entries to the target tier schema provided above. Prefer the `environments` root collection when returning an object.
7. Keep entries operational: capture what to try next time and what to avoid. Avoid vague summaries.

8. Respect each episode's `memory_quality.extraction_priority`: low-priority/progress-only episodes should be ignored unless they contain an explicit reusable blocker, failure mode, or successful pattern in `memory_candidates`, `memory_updates`, actions, or final output excerpts.

Return either a JSON object with an `environments` array matching the target schema, or a bare JSON array of environment entry objects if the model cannot safely wrap it. The runtime will normalize either shape.
Respond with ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no code blocks, no prose.

variables.name: source_json
variables.description: JSON-serialized array of episodic memory entries containing actions_taken and observations

variables.name: source_text
variables.description: Text representation of the episode data for additional context
examples: Episode 1: Navigated to github.com/login, entered credentials, encountered 2FA prompt

variables.name: tier_schema
variables.description: JSON schema describing the target environment_knowledge tier structure

variables.name: identity_section
variables.description: Agent identity context for the consolidation pipeline
examples: ## AGENT IDENTITY CONTEXT\n- Source agent id: agent:personal

variables.name: episode_count
variables.description: Number of episodes in the source data

metadata.description: User prompt instructing the LLM to extract environment knowledge from episodic memory data. Analyzes actions_taken and observations to identify and characterize websites, APIs, CLI tools, and other environments.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.1.0: Prioritizes memory_candidates, final outputs, explicit blockers/failures, and memory_quality; emits environments root when possible and skips one-off task/test artifacts unless reusable behavior is present. v1.0.0: Initial environment knowledge extraction user prompt for memory consolidation pipeline.
